title: 第15章 牛马战龙象第16章 一生相伴共伐诸逆
slug: 师尊修为尽失后宠妻系统来了
content_zh:
第15章牛马战龙象！这话说出来，不止是江清悦，背后的长老和宗主都不会了！
宗门大殿之内，众人都是看着这一幕！
果真如此无情了！
是觉得自身已经修为无望了，打算把弟子都带走是吧！
赵峰沉声道：“宗主，此举不妥，难道真的要让江清悦自尽？她乃是仅次于苏婉卿的神品灵根，未来必然入圣，代价怕是太大了！”
“圣人之姿，未来是我太玄宗提升排名的重要依仗，不可啊！”
“对啊，宗主，此举怕是不妥，那苏婉卿太警惕了！”
众人身前，那面色阴翳的中年男子猛然砸碎桌上案台！
“都已经是废人了，还装模作样！该死的贱货！”
然而此刻还是沉声传音。
“罢了！回来就是，别让她看出破绽，一次不行就两次，两次不行就三次！”
小竹峰内。
江清悦眼神复杂地望着面前苏婉卿，还是缓缓放下长剑，再度跪地。
“弟子自然知道，师尊如今已经不信任任何人了，可弟子对师尊诚诚之心，天地可鉴！”
这次，不自尽了。
改成发誓了。
苏婉卿道心又是近乎崩溃了，看似面带笑容，实则心神绝望。
三十年，三十年培养的弟子，如今居然和宗门一起来算计自己！
到底是为了什么！
江清悦又是开口道：“弟子不会只来一次的，下次，弟子还会........”

“师姐？”
一道声音传来，江清悦疑惑看去。
看到了楚宁，一袭青色道袍，缓缓走来，脸上带着笑容。
在看到那一袭红衣的苏婉卿的时候，楚宁也是一愣。
红衣师尊，气度似乎更好了，但看着眼神似乎不对？
刚刚发生的一切，楚宁是听到了。
那师尊此刻，心神必然不稳固。
楚宁立刻上前扶住苏婉卿，在一旁的位置上坐下，轻声开口道：“师尊，交给弟子就好了。”
苏婉卿心气几乎再要散了，眼下脸上再无笑意，只是神情复杂的望着楚宁。
“宁儿........”
她如今，需要让一切都给弟子承担。
纵使修行还有望，可一件件的事情都是在磨损她的内心。
这小竹峰，不待着也罢，可毕竟在此百年生涯，还有她的老师留下的遗言，让她守好小竹峰。
况且，宗门之内也不会轻易让苏婉卿离开，尤其是对她一直惦记的宗主陈玄天。
怎会如此啊！
她强忍着那种几乎绝望的泪意，死死抓住楚宁的手。
如今，只有弟子是她的寄托。
楚宁没多说什么，只是起身看向了江清悦。
content_en:
Chapter 15 Cows and horses fight dragons and elephants! After saying this, not only Jiang Qingyue, but also the elders and sect masters behind him couldn't do it!
Everyone in the sect hall was watching this scene!
It's really so heartless!
He feels that his cultivation is hopeless, so he plans to take all his disciples away, right?
Zhao Feng said in a deep voice: "Sect Master, this is inappropriate. Do you really want Jiang Qingyue to commit suicide? She has a divine spiritual root second only to Su Wanqing. She will definitely become a saint in the future. The price may be too high!"
"The posture of a saint will be an important basis for our Taixuan Sect to improve our ranking in the future. No way!"
"Yes, Sect Leader, I'm afraid this is inappropriate. Su Wanqing is too vigilant!"
In front of everyone, the middle-aged man with a gloomy face suddenly smashed the table!
"You're already a loser, and you're still pretending! Damn you bitch!"
However, at this moment, there was still a deep voice.
"That's it! Just come back and don't let her see the flaw. If it doesn't work once, do it twice. If it doesn't work twice, do it three times!"
Inside Xiaozhu Peak.
Jiang Qingyue looked at Su Wanqing in front of her with complicated eyes, but slowly put down her sword and knelt down again.
"Of course the disciple knows that the master no longer trusts anyone, but the disciple's sincerity towards the master can be learned from heaven and earth!"
This time, I won’t commit suicide.
Changed to swear.
Su Wanqing's heart was almost broken again. She seemed to be smiling, but in fact she was in despair.
Thirty years, thirty years of training, the disciples are now working with the sect to plot against him!
What is it for?
Jiang Qingyue spoke again: "Disciple will not come just once. Next time, disciple will come again..."
"Sister?"
A voice came, and Jiang Qingyue looked confused.
I saw Chu Ning, dressed in a blue Taoist robe, walking slowly with a smile on her face.
When she saw Su Wanqing in red, Chu Ning was also stunned.
The master in red seems to have a better demeanor, but his eyes seem wrong?
Chu Ning heard everything that just happened.
The master's mind must be unstable at this moment.
Chu Ning immediately stepped forward to support Su Wanqing, sat down on the side, and said softly: "Master, just leave it to the disciples."
Su Wanqing's anger was almost gone. There was no smile on her face now, she just looked at Chu Ning with a complicated expression.
"Ning'er..."
Now, she needs to leave everything to her disciples.
Even though there was still hope for her practice, every incident was wearing on her heart.
It’s fine not to stay at Xiaozhufeng, but after all, she has lived here for a hundred years, and her teacher’s last words told her to keep Xiaozhufeng safe.
Moreover, the sect would not let Su Wanqing leave easily, especially the sect leader Chen Xuantian who had always been thinking about her.
How could this be?
She held back the almost desperate tears and held Chu Ning's hand tightly.
Nowadays, only her disciples are her sustenance.
Chu Ning didn't say much, just stood up and looked at Jiang Qingyue.
